name: CMS Info Systems Ltd
title: CMS Info Systems Ltd - 543441 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FY26 services revenue grew 6% to Rs 2,312 Cr with EBIT margin down 360 bps to 15.6%; Q4 recovered to 19% EBIT, but FY27 Rs 2,700-2,800 Cr services guide needs ~Rs 200 Cr beyond the Rs 2,600 Cr run-rate.

capex.quote: we upped our capex spend significantly to drive higher growth in the coming years, and we have invested Rs.350 Crores of capex in FY2026.

triggers.label: Capex Rs 100 Cr → Rs 350 Cr in FY26
triggers.quote: we upped our capex spend significantly to drive higher growth in the coming years, and we have invested Rs.350 Crores of capex in FY2026.

triggers.label: Transaction-fee ATM contract declined at Rs 19
triggers.quote: we in fact ourselves won a contract for Rs. 700 Crores at a reasonably high transaction fee of Rs. 19 per transaction, but we still chose to stick to our principle

triggers.label: FY27 services guide Rs 2,700-2,800 Cr
triggers.quote: Our services revenue goal remains at Rs. 2700 Crores to Rs. 2800 Crores, which will mean a 17% to 21% growth on FY2026 numbers.

triggers.label: Currency supply dip in Mar-Apr
triggers.quote: We have seen in March and April a dip in currency supply in the country, which impacts ATM transactions.

triggers.label: Q4 margin recovery +280 bps
triggers.quote: I am glad to report that we are able to sharply improve margins by 280 bps in Q4

guidance.quote: Our services revenue goal remains at Rs. 2700 Crores to Rs. 2800 Crores
we are targeting Rs. 2800 Crores to Rs.2900 Crores, which would mean a 13% to 17% growth.
we are still aiming to be in the 25% EBITDA margin range
Over the next four years, we see our opportunity to accelerate this growth to a 13 % to 14% CAGR
the board has approved Rs. 168 Crores buyback, roughly 3% of our outstanding equity shares, at Rs.340 price point.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we aimed to expand margins by 150 to 170 bps in Q4 and another similar expansion in FY 2027. I am glad to report that we are able to sharply improve margins by 280 bps in Q4
In February we had mentioned that Q3 will be the bottom for us on margins

red_flags.label: Receivables stress at MSP customers
red_flags.quote: we have converted what was our exposure into a secure outstanding

red_flags.label: Q1 currency supply dip risk
red_flags.quote: We have seen in March and April a dip in currency supply in the country, which impacts ATM transactions.

evasions.quote: we will wait to see how Q1 goes through
Let us finish the deal in Q1, Baidik, and after that we can tell you better.
we really do not get into these levels of details on margins
